The only thing I wished it had was some kind of handle on the side with no wheels to move easily. This is why I only gave it 4 stars.  I’m unable to use the side tray to move it because by lifting up on it   is how you put the side tray down.. another solution would be to put 4 wheels on it.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, heats evenly and good control of temperature

are looking forward to many years of outdoor grilling!
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I’ve been a Weber fan forever. They are the best especially in durability. However, this model  needs another set of wheels . It’s very difficult to move the grill to different locations on my deck . In fact, when trying to move it and position it , a wheel fell off. Also, the Weber cover designed for this model is not functional . The Velcro does not adhere. Not satisfied at all with the overly priced cover . It needs straps not just Velcro .

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We have had Weber grills before but recently have bought cheaper ones.  We went back to Weber because they are so solidly built.  It is just the right size and heats fast and accurately.
Results.Title: Solid Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Replaced my 25 year old Weber grill. Hope this one is the same.
Results.Title: Easy to use and starts every time.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I bought this grill a couple of months ago. The various parts in the assembly directions are not marked with any numbering or letters making assembly a pain!  I used BILT app & it was ok. After I had all the parts unpacked & they were well packaged, I found that I had no hardware to assemble my grill! I went through all the packaging 3 more times, no hardware. I called customer service who was very helpful. This was taking place on a Thursday afternoon. I had planned a family BBQ for Sunday . I  asked the lady how long it would be to get my parts? She laughed a little & said next week. I asked if parts could be sent any quicker & no it didn't happen. When I received my parts the latter part of next week my enthusiasm over my new grill purchase was about gone I have assembled many grills over 40 plus years of grilling. This was my worst experience  On the  plus side  the grill heats up quick & holds temperature well. If you want to keep the temperature lower & consistent  ease it up to begin with not wide open. It does have a hotter spot which is the left rear corner. Just 
 rotate your food & all is well. I am pleased with this grill over all!
Results.Title: Works as expected.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grill is super durable and easy to clean. Cooks food perfectly. Easy to put together. The pilot light works great and I love that the batteries can be replaced easily so I am not stuck match lighting when it wears out. Worth every penny.
Results.Title: Top of the line grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Our grill came with a faulty hose, which we reported.  So far it's taken a month and 3 emails and we still don't have a replacement. They want pictures, soapy water testing, etc.  
We borrowed another hose, which worked -- so why do we have to go through all these steps, before we send back the brand new leaky hose?  Anyway, I wouldn't count on the 10 year parts warranty.  We wanted to use our grill, so bought a replacement hose and are still waiting for the Weber company to come through with a replacement.  The grill works nicely.  I like the stainless parts and hope it will last longer than my other grills have.
Results.Title: Nice Grill -- but warranty on parts is a hassle

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

You pay more for a Weber, but you easily get it back in the long run.  Heats fast, cooks evenly and now a 10 year parts warranty.  This one is just the right size for my wife and me.

The grilling area is a little larger, and I appreciate that when the family is home. I like the fact that the burners run from front to back instead of across. I think it makes usage more flexible. I bought this at one of the full service specialty stores, and I'm glad I did. The price was excellent, and it was really nice to buy the grill assembled and ready to go - after hooking up my LP tank, of course.

Weber is a good grill, I only gave it four stars because there is one thing you could improve on. I used to have a weber to 210 that had four swivel wheels which made it easier to maneuver. Swivel wheels on this model would improve it greatly.  The two stationary legs means you have to lift it to move it, a bit heavy.

Just a thought weber!
Results.Title: One Improvement

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Operates very well and the heat seems quite even. Well constructed and easy to assemble, although there was no room for error. If you lost a screw, for example, there was no replacement. Never lost any, but some might. I live on the Chesapeake Bay and critters abound. At night, they get up on the shelf below the grill to get at what they smell inside and push up the lightweight device covering the opening at the bottom which then falls out. I couldn't find an explanation for the purpose of the thing. Though the grill is obviously set up for a rotisserie, finding one that fits has been difficult. What helped convince me was the customer service given my bro-in-law and the parts availability. My old grill had a lifetime guarantee on the burners which were bronze. The valves started sticking badly and when I tried to get replacements, was told they didn't make them anymore. Useless guarantee. My in-law got a part for his years-old Weber next day.
Results.Title: Really Great, But...

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Results.Title: Best grill I've owned!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We have had this grill for about 6 weeks. It’s the perfect size for us , a 2 person cottage in a retirement village, small enough for our patio but big enough to cook for company. It heats up very quickly, cooks evenly and maintains accurate cooking temperatures. My only criticism is that it would be nice to have a handle in the side to make it easier to move it around. Overall we are very pleased with the grill. How long it lasts is yet to be determined. That is why we are happy to have the 10 year warranty.

Needs a handle or something.

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill a couple months ago, and it continues to amaze.  This thing heats up faster than any grill I've ever owned; will literally hit 500 degrees within 5-6 minutes.  Food is cooked evenly throughout the entire grilling area, which is also an issue I've had with grills in the past.  Just the perfect grill.
Results.Title: WOW what a grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I bought my grill in April and wanted to wait on a review because it sounds unreal. There is on thing I don’t like about the grill, nothing has broken, and it was easy to assemble. 

Grill arrived extremely well packed and every piece was in perfect condition. Weber has an online interactive assemble video that made assembly, fast, easy, and no misread or error to correct. 

I have cooked almost every lunch and dinner on the grill since I got it. The electronic ignition has worked every time in spite of rain and wind. The cast iron grates are perfect for putting strips on my NY Strips. Heat is even and plentiful. I did have to adjust my cooking because everything cooks very quickly. 

Clean up is fast and easy. After cooling down I spray the top side shelves and shelf in the bass with a mixture of ½ water ½ vinegar. After almost 3 months of constant use it looks like new.
